checks.name: calibration SD is the sample SD of log rates
runs are ordered by training start, not argument order
A/A calibration has no candidate decision
more blocks are needed for a smaller gain
block count follows the normal approximation
consistent gains give a positive interval and promotion
a positive mean with an interval including zero is a stack candidate
one block is not enough for a decision
differing trained weights are reported as non-exact
timed blocks use the trimmed per-update estimator
a start-up spike in a reference run does not inflate the trimmed block effect
two blocks of a 2% gain promote under the calibrated SD
no true gain is not promoted under the calibrated SD
